key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A6D2
name: scan_table_for_status_byte
description: Walks a fixed table of entries, advancing a stored cursor past empty slots until it finds a nonzero entry, then returns that entry's status byte clamped to non-negative values. It returns zero when its countdown runs out or the stop flag is set.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A6D6
name: scan_table_wrapping_for_entry
description: Works like the other table scan but resets the stored cursor to the start of the table when it reaches the end, so the search wraps around. It returns the status byte of the first nonzero entry, clamped to non-negative values, or zero when its countdown expires.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A700
name: find_text_in_record_table
description: Compares a zero-terminated search text against the text fields of ten 26-byte records and returns one when the text occurs inside a record, restarting the comparison on each mismatch. It returns zero when no record contains the text.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A724
name: scan_records_for_text_match
description: Walks a counted list of 26-byte records and checks each one for the search text, restarting the match whenever a character differs. It returns one when a full match is found and zero when the records run out.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A732
name: search_text_in_later_records
description: Steps to the next 26-byte record before each comparison, then searches for the zero-terminated text inside it. It returns one on a match and zero when the record count is exhausted.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:add21k:0:0000
name: refresh_display_and_close_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries, sets a byte in a display structure, calls the library functions that free raster memory and remake the display, then closes both libraries.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:wait:0:0000
name: allocate_and_install_handler_buffer
description: Finds the largest value stored in a linked list, allocates a buffer sized from it, and fills the buffer with an increasing sequence of tag values. It copies sixteen longs out and back around a library call, stores a handler address in the buffer, and returns minus one when allocation fails.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:wait:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed table in memory into the buffer passed on the stack when that buffer pointer is non-null, then calls a library function through a stored pointer.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:nofastmem:0:0000
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Allocates a record, copies the command line from the process structure, and splits it on spaces and tabs into zero-terminated arguments in a linked list. Quoted arguments honour star escapes for newline and escape, and the routine returns an error code when allocation fails.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:nofastmem:2:0000
name: steal_memory_or_report_error
description: Repeatedly tries to take over a memory allocation vector and checks that the replacement held, and when it cannot it displays an error console window whose message is chosen by the parameter. It restores the saved vector pointers before returning.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:nofastmem:4:0000
name: invoke_stored_function_one
description: Calls through the function pointer held in a shared variable with no arguments, then returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:nofastmem:4:000C
name: invoke_stored_function_two
description: Calls through the function pointer held in a second shared variable with no arguments, then returns.

name: run_state_machine_loop
description: Runs an endless state loop that resets a shared state byte and calls the helper routines for each step, breaking out to run its finishing helpers when the state reaches its final value.

name: initialize_runtime_state_flags
description: Calls setup helpers in the runtime segment, clears a block of shared state variables, sets a countdown to 499, then returns the result of a final helper call with the constant 132 ORed in.

name: wait_until_counter_reaches_four
description: Spins until a shared counter reaches four, then resets that counter to zero.

name: countdown_polling_flag_bit
description: Counts a shared value down in nested loops, leaving early when its flag bit is set, and finally waits until that flag bit clears.

name: run_counter_driven_step_loop
description: Initialises a state value, then repeatedly runs a step of helper routines that update the shared counter and call the timing and table helpers. It returns early when a helper reports completion or the counter goes negative.

name: run_countdown_sequence_steps
description: Runs a setup helper, then when the counter is non-zero runs eighty steps of helper calls, including a special call near the end, and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns the state value.

name: run_state_step_loop_from_two
description: Like the other step loop, but starts from a state value of two and calls a different setup helper first, then repeats the step helpers until the state goes negative.

name: step_state_until_exit
description: Repeats a step body that calls helpers and adjusts a shared state value, returning once the state goes negative or a helper signals completion.

name: advance_table_index_with_flag
description: Increments a shared index, looks up a byte in a fixed table using bits of that index, and sets the high bit when the looked-up value is greater than one.

name: print_status_text_by_flag
description: Chooses one of two zero-terminated text strings from a shared flag, adding the character for zero to a shared value when that value is zero, and sends the characters one at a time to an output helper.

name: print_fixed_string_message
description: Calls a setup helper, then writes a fixed zero-terminated text one character at a time through the output helper.

name: print_message_after_setup
description: Runs a preparation call and a setup helper, then writes a second fixed text one character at a time through the output helper.

name: finish_mode_and_reset_state
description: Calls a shared helper, then for modes three and five calls a mode-specific helper, and finally marks the shared value as minus one.

name: print_string_after_init_call
description: Calls an initialisation helper, then writes a fixed zero-terminated message one character at a time through the output helper.

name: spin_while_flag_set
description: Returns immediately when the shared flag is clear. When the flag is set it spins until the flag clears and then loops endlessly without returning.

name: copy_buffer_in_long_pairs
description: Calls a setup helper, then copies a block of four thousand pairs of 32-bit words from one buffer to another, and finishes with two helper calls.

name: run_mode_dependent_setup_steps
description: Runs one or two extra helper calls depending on whether a shared mode value equals nine, then runs a fixed series of helper calls and returns.

name: call_six_helpers_in_order
description: Calls one shared helper and then five further helper routines in a fixed order, with no data handling of its own.

name: call_long_helper_sequence
description: Calls a long fixed sequence of helper routines in order, including a shared helper call near the start, and returns.

name: run_helpers_then_copy_pairs
description: Runs ten helper calls, then copies four thousand pairs of 32-bit words from one buffer to another and returns.

name: busy_wait_then_call_helpers
description: Counts a value down through its full wrap-around range as a delay, then calls two helper routines and returns.

name: clear_buffer_and_copy_blocks
description: Clears eight thousand longs of a buffer and runs a series of helper calls. It then copies rows of 32-bit words from two source tables into the buffer and into three further areas spaced two thousand longs apart.

name: clear_buffer_and_call_helpers
description: Clears eight thousand longs of a buffer, then calls a series of helper routines in pairs and restores the saved buffer pointer before returning.

name: print_string_argument
description: Calls a setup helper, then sends a zero-terminated text passed in through the address register one character at a time to an output helper, and returns zero.

name: build_bit_reversed_byte_table
description: Fills a 256-byte table where each entry is the bit-reversed form of its index.

name: lookup_indexed_value_with_status
description: Loads a value from a table indexed by a shared counter and clears that counter. It returns the loaded value with the constant 132 ORed in when a status word is non-negative and two bits match; the other path is undecoded noise.

name: call_helper_pair_then_vector
description: Calls two helper routines, then calls a function through a pointer held in a shared variable at a fixed offset, and returns.

name: call_helper_pair_then_vector_gap
description: Matches the routine before it: it calls two helper routines and then calls the function at a fixed offset through a shared pointer. It is only reached through an undecoded gap in the code.

name: call_six_helpers_then_vector
description: Calls six helper routines in sequence, then calls a function through a pointer held in a shared variable at a fixed offset.

name: expand_run_length_words
description: Copies 16-bit words from a source buffer to a destination. Entries with a marked high byte repeat the following word a counted number of times, and the copy stops when a run count of eight is read.

name: call_five_helpers_then_vector
description: Calls five helper routines in sequence, then calls a function through a pointer held in a shared variable at a fixed offset.

name: call_three_helpers_then_vector
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence, then calls a function through a pointer held in a shared variable at a fixed offset.

name: decode_runs_into_fixed_buffer
description: Sets a shared mode value to one, then expands run-length encoded words into a fixed destination buffer and stops at a run count of eight.

name: decode_runs_mode_two
description: Sets a shared mode value to two, then expands run-length encoded words into the buffer held in a shared variable and stops at a run count of eight.

name: expand_runs_into_given_buffer
description: Expands run-length encoded words from the source held in a shared variable into the destination pointer supplied by the caller, stopping at a run count of eight, after calling three helper routines.

name: setup_four_audio_channels
description: Points each of the four audio channels at the same sample address with a length of sixteen words, zero volume and period 400. It then disables the four audio interrupt bits and sets shared state values.

name: update_audio_volumes_from_table
description: When a shared flag is set, runs four helper calls and then copies three table bytes, each doubled, into the volume registers of the first three audio channels.

name: dispatch_pending_state_handler
description: Moves a pending state byte into the active slot when one is set, clears the pending slot, then calls the handler selected by that state from a dispatch table.

name: reset_channel_state_fields
description: Clears a shared flag and six status bytes in a channel record, then sets a 16-bit counter field to fifteen.

name: select_index_from_threshold
description: Sets a shared index to thirty-two or sixty-three depending on whether the input value is below one hundred twenty-eight, calls helper routines, and then advances the index by one.

name: advance_index_with_table_check
description: Calls helper routines, runs four more when the input value is even, and advances a shared index by one, or by two when the next table entry matches it.

name: test_mask_table_bit_and_call
description: Returns zero unless a bit mask in the input matches a table entry selected by the low four bits of a shared counter. When it matches, it returns the result of a helper call.

name: clear_channel_status_bytes
description: Clears six status bytes in a channel record and sets a 16-bit counter field to fifteen, the same reset as its neighbouring routine.

name: increment_counter_wrap_at_input
description: Increments a shared byte and resets it to zero when it reaches the value passed in the data register.

name: store_table_word_in_record
description: Calls two helper routines, then stores a 16-bit value from a fixed table, indexed by the input byte, into a field of the record in the address register.

name: store_table_word_at_offset
description: Stores a 16-bit value from a fixed table, indexed by the input byte, into the record at an offset given by the data register.

name: advance_or_reset_sequence_counter
description: Increments a shared sequence counter. When the incremented value matches the fixed table entry for the current counter, the counter is replaced by the input byte and then incremented.

name: start_record_from_table_byte
description: If a byte from a table at the given position is nonzero, computes a table index from that byte and a base value, stores the resulting word and a zero status in a record, then runs an update step and counts down a companion value.

name: start_record_from_table_byte_b
description: Uses the same table-driven start logic as its neighbour, but writes the results into a record with a different field layout.

name: start_record_from_table_byte_c
description: Uses the same table-driven start logic as its neighbours, but writes the results into a record with a third field layout.

name: step_record_counter_with_table
description: Increments a byte in a record. When it reaches the limit stored beside it, resets it, decrements a companion counter and updates a second field from a table.

name: store_value_then_run_helpers
description: Stores the value passed in the address register into a shared variable, then calls five helper routines in sequence.

name: initialize_memory_and_library_base
description: Clears a block of shared variables, uses exec library calls to open a library and allocate memory, then stores three offset pointers for the allocated area. If a step fails it calls a failure routine and loops forever.

name: install_interrupt_server_then_halt
description: Calls an exec library function through a shared library base to add an interrupt server, then loops forever without returning.

name: configure_display_and_copper
description: Points a shared pointer at a copper list, waits through a long countdown, then writes the display window, data fetch, bitplane modulo and copper pointer registers, and enables copper interrupts.

name: fill_table_entries_and_copy_words
description: Stores the input byte plus a comma character in a shared variable, writes four 32-bit values spaced 8000 apart into a table, then copies sixteen words from the source, doubled, into a second fixed array.

name: call_four_helper_routines
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: retry_library_call_until_success
description: Repeatedly calls a library function with a fixed code value until it returns a nonzero result. Between attempts it calls a helper, advances a shared offset by 256 and busy-waits, then stores the successful result in a shared variable.

name: store_library_result_or_halt
description: Calls a library function through a shared library base. A nonzero result is stored in a shared variable, while a zero result calls a failure routine and then loops forever.

name: call_shared_library_function_a
description: Calls a library function through a shared library base at a fixed offset and returns without using its result.

name: call_shared_library_function_b
description: Calls a library function through a shared library base at a different fixed offset and returns without using its result.

name: call_shared_library_function_c
description: Calls a library function through a shared library base at a third fixed offset and returns without using its result.

name: toggle_slot_and_run_helpers
description: Toggles a shared index between zero and one, calls the function pointer stored in the selected slot, runs three helper routines and sets a shared flag to one.

name: run_helpers_when_pending
description: When a shared value equals minus one, runs two helper routines around a store and sets the value to one.

name: handle_interrupt_line_countdown
description: Checks four interrupt request bits. For each line that is both requested and active it counts the occurrences; on the third count it disables that interrupt by writing its enable bit and sets a shared stage value to one, two, four or eight.

name: record_keyboard_key_state
description: Decodes a byte from the keyboard serial register by inverting and rotating it. If the code is below two hundred thirty-two it records the 7-bit key code in a key-state table, storing zero for release events.

name: clear_byte_at_offset
description: Stores a zero byte at an address formed by the base pointer plus the offset in the data register.

name: combine_direction_state_flags
description: Combines direction state into a set of flag bits in a shared variable, then steps two counter values toward zero by ten each. It returns early when the shared value is already nonzero.

name: decode_joystick_port_one
description: Sets direction and fire flag bits in a shared byte, with the top bit set when it is clear, and references the joystick port one registers. The decoded code only manipulates shared variables, so the register reads are not visible.

name: compute_mouse_movement_deltas
description: Computes horizontal and vertical movement deltas from shared counters and mouse-port values, then stores the adjusted values back into shared variables.

name: set_shared_value_minus_one
description: Sets a shared 16-bit variable to all ones, which reads as minus one.

name: wait_until_shared_value_zero
description: Spins until a shared variable reads zero, then returns.

name: map_nibble_bits_to_flag
description: Updates a shared flag byte from the low four bits of the input, setting or clearing bit number six for each bit. It returns early when the nibble equals the stored value.

name: copy_nibble_bits_to_flag
description: Copies the four low bits of the input into a shared flag byte by setting or clearing bit number six for each of them.

name: write_bit_flags_at_position
description: Writes bit flags into a shared byte at the bit position given in the data register, using the input value's bits one through three in sequence.

name: write_upper_bit_flags_at_position
description: Writes flags for the upper two input bits into a shared byte at the bit position given in the data register.

name: write_high_flag_bit_at_position
description: Clears the bit at the position given in the data register within a shared byte, then sets it again when the input has the eight bit set.

name: clear_bit_at_position
description: Clears the bit at the position given in the data register within a shared byte.

name: fill_rows_with_four_word_pattern
description: Calls four helper routines, then fills 200 rows of a 32000-byte area with a repeating four-value pattern read from a fixed table, writing backwards from the end of the area.

name: fill_rows_with_word_pattern
description: Fills 200 rows of a 32000-byte area with a repeating four-value pattern read from a fixed table, writing backwards from the end of the area. It makes no helper calls.

name: call_single_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

name: copy_eight_longs_in_place
description: Walks eight 32-bit values from a shared pointer and writes each one back to the same position, so as decoded it has no visible effect.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Calls five helper routines, waits until the blitter busy flag clears, then calls one more helper routine.

name: program_blitter_for_rectangle
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then programs its source and destination pointers, modulo values, control words and a size computed from the width and height inputs.

name: forbid_multitasking_and_call_library
description: Calls a library function through a shared base at a fixed offset, then calls the exec function that disables multitasking, and returns the data registers unchanged.

name: call_library_then_permit
description: Calls a library function through a shared base at a fixed offset, then calls the exec function that re-enables multitasking, and returns the data registers unchanged.

name: clear_table_and_set_top_bit
description: Clears a block of 532 16-bit words at a fixed address, then writes the value 32768 into the word just after the block.

name: store_pair_into_record
description: Returns immediately when a shared flag is set. Otherwise it calls a helper and stores two 16-bit input values into fields of the record in the address register.

name: store_pair_with_busy_flag
description: Sets a shared flag, calls a helper, stores two 16-bit input values into a record, then clears the flag.

name: store_pair_after_flagged_helper
description: Calls a helper, then sets a shared flag while it stores two 16-bit input values into a record, and clears the flag afterwards.

name: store_value_after_helper
description: Calls a helper routine, then stores a 16-bit input value into a fixed field of the record in the address register.

name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: Chooses one of four audio channels from the low bits of the index, points it at a sample address with a period and volume, waits a short countdown, then writes its final volume and length and updates its enable bits.

name: store_library_result_and_release
description: Calls a library function through a shared base. When it returns a nonzero value, stores that value in a shared variable, calls a helper, then calls a second library function.
